notes.title: Blackrock – Patchnotes | Experimental Story Seeds & Smarter Squads
notes.notes:
[p]🧪 [b]Experimental Content[/b][/p][p]First story elements have made their way into the game – but they’re [i]not[/i] just sitting in plain sight.
Those who click the [b]Story button[/b]... very, very often... might discover something. 😉[/p][p]A secret place called the [b]Karma Room[/b] has also been added. What does it mean? Nobody knows for sure – but it definitely feels... different.
[i](Note: Story & Karma are experimental and will be expanded. You can always return to the main menu using ESC or SELECT.)[/i][/p][p]I want to share these systems with you, even if they’re not finished yet – that’s why I’m keeping them in, even if hidden.[/p][p]But they’ll never interfere with the current gameplay experience. If that ever becomes a risk, I’ll hold experimental features back until they’re ready.[/p][p]🧠 [b]Improved Squad AI[/b][/p][p]Your companions (Beta, Lambda, Zulu) now follow you automatically at a smart distance and attack enemies once they’re in range [i]and[/i] visible.[/p][p]You can toggle follow behavior per unit using:[/p][list][*][p](A/B/Y) on [b]Xbox[/b][/p][/*][*][p](Cross/Circle/Triangle) on [b]PlayStation[/b][/p][/*][*][p](Y/X/C) on [b]Keyboard[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Targeting system reworked: attacks are now smarter and respect line of sight.[/p][p]🔥 [b]Combat, Effects & Performance[/b][/p][p]Target lines have been visually reworked for improved clarity.[/p][p]Generator particle effects optimized – fewer FPS drops, more [i]kaboom[/i].[/p][p]Attack animations and hit timing cleaned up (no more sprite flickering).[/p][p]🚀 [b]Pathfinding & Movement[/b][/p][p]New pathfinding logic for squad AI: less lag, more brain.[/p][p]Squad units adjust their spacing to the player and navigate efficiently – even through the darker story levels.[/p][p]No more endless recalculations – delay logic has been added.[/p][p]🎯 [b]Spawns & Enemies[/b][/p][p]Enemy caps in the Karma Room now scale with your [b]survival time[/b] – it won’t get out of hand.
...Unless you survive too long 😅[/p][p]Balancing will take more time and testing – I appreciate your patience while I fine-tune the madness.[/p][p]Spawn logic and intervals have been reworked for a more even flow of action.[/p][p]🎨 [b]Visuals & UI[/b][/p][p]An [b]epilepsy warning[/b] has been added for rooms with strong flickering effects.
(This includes a tiny Easter egg that may – or may not – lead to the Karma Room.)[/p][p]Light surfaces are now only created when needed. I’ve realized I picked up a bad habit here… but I’m on it.[/p][p]Menu and GUI elements have been refined – especially in Karma and Story levels.[/p][p]🪨 [b]And Else?[/b][/p][p]Meteorites in the Spacetrain level used to be invisible? Not anymore![/p][p]Various smaller fixes and improvements to draw events, visual effects, and debug output.[/p]

notes.title: Some small fixes
notes.notes:
🪨 Stoneworms & Scorps got nerfed (a bit)
They were acting like ancient gods of annihilation, so we slowed them down a notch. Your troops might now have a chance to actually breathe before dying.

💥 Generator explosion toned down
On older systems, the visual kaboom was a bit too much kaboom. Now it’s still boom, just less doom for your framerate. Visual difference? Barely noticeable. Performance? Noticeably better.

🎬 Hidden Intro Cutscene Fix
Turns out the camera had a little wanderlust and drifted too far left. It’s now properly focused, so the secret image is displayed as intended. Yes, there's a hidden intro. No, you didn't imagine that.

notes.title: Miniupdate
notes.notes:
[p]🦂 [b]Scorpions and Stoneworms have been upgraded from "AI Potato" to "Slightly Functional Predators."[/b]
They should no longer stand around like confused statues when trying to kill something. No more “Wait, how do I attack again?” moments. Probably.[/p][p]⚠️ [b]Added a warning when going above 100 troops.[/b]
On my trusty Potato Test Rig™, I noticed how the FPS starts to plummet when pushing past the 100 troop limit. Just because you [i]can[/i] doesn’t mean you [i]should[/i]. Going above that might summon lag demons from the 5th dimension. You’ve been warned.[/p][p]💻 On modern systems, the max limit of 200 should still run pretty smoothly, though.[/p][p]I’ll keep trying to squeeze out more performance here and there, so we might be able to push the limits even further in the future.[/p][p]🧠 Note: When I say 100, I mean [i]separately[/i] for troops and enemies. That means you can have up to [b]200 active units[/b] at once.
(Plus the occasional natural wildlife… like those majestic Stoneworms.)[/p][p]👀 Tiny spoiler: I’m planning to add more of these natural creatures in the future – but I’ll be waiting for your feedback first.[/p][hr][/hr][p]❤️
Much love,
[b]Joe[/b][/p]
